title: Fantastic
text: Fantastic. For years I been thinking and looking at a robot like this. Since you had the sale I finally bought one. I was so pleasantly surprised by how easy it was to set it up and how smart this little thing is, I could not believe how well it cleaned each room and it even runs into the carpeted bedrooms. and it does a 99% great job. This robot knows where to go and it so quiet I forgot about it, and thought I had to search for it. To my shock, this little robot found his home and plugged itself in. It makes life easy for me and the battery lasted a long time, I have a 3000 square home and it did every room except 2 bedrooms batteries lasted 2 hours. I recommend it highly. Wished I purchased this a long time ago. Great invention.

product_metadata.title: ILIFE V8s Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo, Big 750ml Dustbin, Enhanced Suction Inlet, Zigzag Cleaning Path, LCD Display, Schedule, Self-Charging Robot Vacuum Cleaner, Ideal for Hard Floor and Pet Hair.
features: 【Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo】:Vacuuming system with Gen 3 CyclonePower System provides a powerful suction in vacuum mode. Mopping system with intelligent water tank, adjustable water output for adapting to different floor types. One Robot, Thorough Clean.
【Large 750ml Dustbin】: A large dustbin ensures the V8s clean larger spaces without frequent emptying.

【Enhanced Suction Inlet】: The unique suction structure ensures that pet hair and debris go into the dustbin easily which makes the V8s great for pet owners. The floating design self-adjusts to adapt to different types of floors.
【LCD Display】: Easy to read icons are great for any user to easily operate.
【Endurance Cleaning】: V8s lasts up to 110 minutes with a full charge, automatically recharges, always prepares to clean the floor.
Warranty for new robot is 12 months, for refurbished robot is 3 months.
